description: Source code for a Watchdog driver module implementing watchdog control functions for MPC55xx series microcontrollers, including start, stop, mode setting, and trigger functions.

methods.name: StartWatchdog
methods.description: Initializes and starts the watchdog timer with a specified timeout in milliseconds.

methods.name: Wdg_Init
methods.description: Initializes the watchdog driver with configuration parameters.

methods.name: Wdg_SetMode
methods.description: Sets the watchdog mode (off, fast, slow) based on the provided mode type.

methods.name: Wdg_Trigger
methods.description: Services (kicks) the internal watchdog timer to prevent reset.
